dialogue.conversations: A real conversation?! %1$s, this just cracked the top three of my whole day! Okay okay — ask me ANYTHING!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.good: SO good! The bread rose, the chickens marched in a LINE — a line! — and now you're here asking!
dialogue.conversations.checkin.rough: Rough patch, honestly! But you asked, so it's officially turning around — that's just how it works!
dialogue.conversations.day.good: Best day! Okay, top three! The well water was SO cold and I only tripped over the bucket once!
dialogue.conversations.day.rough: Honestly? Not great! But a bad morning is just a good afternoon warming up. Probably!
dialogue.conversations.work.like: LOVE it! There's a rhythm, and I hum along, and sometimes the humming becomes a whole song — anyway YES!
dialogue.conversations.work.hate: Between us? Some days I smile at the work so hard my face aches by lunch. Don't tell it I said that!
dialogue.conversations.life.first: Ooh, story time! Born here, loved it, scraped every knee twice, named the well bucket — where do I even START, %1$s?
dialogue.conversations.dreams.first: The ocean! I want to yell at the ocean and hear it yell back! It's going to be the BEST! Top one, easy!
dialogue.conversations.fears.first: That one morning the cheer won't come, and everyone finds out how hard I row to keep it. ...ANYWAY! Also spiders!
dialogue.conversations.feelings.first: You're top three, %1$s! People-wise! Okay, fine, top ONE. Don't make it weird, I have chores!
dialogue.conversations.deflect.personal: Ooh, big question! Too big for now! But keep coming around and I will absolutely overshare someday, promise!
dialogue.conversations.deflect.intimate: That one lives on the bottom shelf of the heart! We're still up top — great shelf! — but keep climbing, %1$s!
dialogue.conversations.gossip.none: Nothing new! A chicken sat on the fence for a whole HOUR though. I watched all of it. Riveting stuff!
dialogue.chat: STOP EVERYTHING — we're having a conversation! This is the BEST interruption all week, %1$s!
